scope: Isolated Chrome and synthetic fund data; external traffic blocked; no real user data, service or device.

checks.name: Two funds show price, allocation and entry/exit plans with all diagnostic checks hidden by default
Current quote, manual reference, unmet entry and unknown entry remain distinct
320/390 px and 1x/1.3x font layouts have no overflow; reading does not modify the fund plan
A single evidence entrance expands and fully hides the complete check
Dividend amount visibility also masks fund prices and allocations
Budget edits save and survive reload, recalculate allocation, and preserve every fund input
Long-term and rebalancing modes state their own exit arrangement; 70:30 allocation remains exact
